Interop Resolution Service

API reference for Onyx: member resolution, POST /v1/interop/resolve.

Version v1 · Point32Health · the OpenAPI document (YAML and JSON) that ships with this page carries the same contract.

8 Timeouts, retries, security

1 Overview

Onyx's interop lookups. Member resolution, POST /v1/interop/resolve: resolves an EMR-supplied member ID against the plan's member records, reports whether coverage is active on the date of service, and returns the ID as resolved and in every UM vendor's format, each with the payer for that vendor's request.

One call per prior authorization. Send the member id exactly as the provider's EMR supplied it, the date of service (or the period of service) and, when known, the patient's date of birth. The answer says whether the member was found, whether coverage is active on that date, the line of business to route on, and the member id in every UM vendor's format with the payer to put on that vendor's request.

Base URL and credentials are issued by Point32Health API Management for each environment and are not part of this document. The path below is relative to that base URL.

2 The operation

POST /v1/interop/resolve with Content-Type: application/json. The service always answers JSON, whatever Accept header is sent; every response carries Cache-Control: no-store and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. The call is a pure read and may be repeated; it is a POST because the member id is PHI and must not appear in a URL.

Finds the member behind the id the EMR typed, says whether coverage is active on the date of service (or on every day of a period of service), and returns the id as resolved and in every configured UM vendor's format (memberId.forVendors), each entry with the payer for that vendor's request (payerId, payerName). When several members on the plan match and no dateOfBirth settles it, the outcome is AMBIGUOUS and the message says what to resend; the other members are never listed. clientId, clientType (EXT or INT), requestId and memberId are required; unknown properties are ignored. A sent date is the date evaluated; an unusable date is a 400. POST because the member id is PHI and must not appear in URLs; the operation is a pure read and may be repeated.

Headers

HeaderDirectionRule
X-Correlation-IdinOptional transport-level id, 1 to 64 characters of letters, digits, ., _, : or -; opaque. Missing or invalid: the service generates one. The caller's own id for the call is requestId in the body.
X-Correlation-IdoutThe echoed or generated value; also in the body of error responses as correlationId.
Retry-AfteroutOn 503 only: seconds to wait before retrying (10).

Responses

StatusMeaning
200outcome ACTIVE | INACTIVE | NOT_FOUND | AMBIGUOUS; memberId.forVendors, each vendor with its payer, present for ACTIVE and INACTIVE
400INVALID_REQUEST for a missing or unusable clientId, clientType or requestId, a missing memberId, an unusable date or a body that is not JSON; MEMBER_LOOKUP_REJECTED when the member lookup answered 400 (details[0].code HTTP_400, the lookup's text in the message)
422DOB_MISMATCH: the date of birth matches no record for this id
502MEMBER_LOOKUP_ERROR or MEMBER_LOOKUP_INVALID_RESPONSE (the member lookup); MEMBER_PLAN_ERROR or MEMBER_PLAN_INVALID_RESPONSE (the member plan lookup)
503MEMBER_LOOKUP_UNAVAILABLE or MEMBER_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE; retry after the Retry-After seconds; header Retry-After (Seconds to wait before retrying)
500INTERNAL_ERROR: the service itself failed; retry once later, then alert the service owners with the correlationId and requestId

3 Request

Member resolution request: clientId, clientType, requestId and memberId are required; unknown properties are ignored; a sent date must be usable. Unknown properties are ignored, so a vendor sent by habit does no harm: the answer is always for every vendor.

FieldTypeRequiredMeaning
clientIdstringyesThe calling system, as registered with the plan: letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', at most 50 characters
clientTypeEXT | INTyesEXT for a caller outside the plan, INT for an internal one
requestIdstringyesThe caller's id for this call, unique per request; echoed in the response and in every error response. Letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' or '-', at most 64 characters
memberIdstringyesThe member id exactly as the EMR supplied it. Looked up unchanged (surrounding whitespace removed); no shape, length or character check. The example is a masked pattern: a THP Medicare card number is a letter and 8 digits
dateOfServicestringDate of service, yyyy-MM-dd; the first date when the service covers a period. Defaults to today when omitted (dateOfServiceDefaulted is true). A sent value is the date evaluated: any future date is judged on the coverage on record; not a real date, or more than 10 years back, is a 400.
dateOfServiceEndstringOptional last date of service, yyyy-MM-dd, when the service covers a period: coverage must hold on every day from dateOfService to it. Not before dateOfService; needs dateOfService.
dateOfBirthstringOptional patient date of birth, yyyy-MM-dd, used only to verify the member or to tell apart the members on a plan who share the id. Never logged, never echoed.

4 Response (200)

The answer: the outcome Onyx branches on, one sentence for a person, the member id as received, as resolved and in every vendor's format with that vendor's payer, the line of business, the date evaluated, the coverage flag with its period, the caller's requestId and a traceId for support. A field that does not apply is absent, never null. Fields are sent in the order listed.

FieldTypeRequiredMeaning
outcomeACTIVE | INACTIVE | NOT_FOUND | AMBIGUOUSyesACTIVE: member found, coverage active on the date of service (or on every day of the period). INACTIVE: member found, not covered on that date or not on every day of the period; message says why. NOT_FOUND: no member for this id on that date. AMBIGUOUS: several members match and nothing sent tells them apart; message says what to resend
messagestringyesOne sentence for a person reading the answer. Branch on outcome, not on this text
memberIdobjectyesThe member id as received, as resolved, and in every vendor's format
memberId.receivedstringyesThe member id as sent, surrounding whitespace removed
memberId.resolvedstringThe id the lookup resolved to, as the plan stores it; for a converted member a different number from the one received. ACTIVE and INACTIVE only
memberId.forVendors[]arrayThe resolved id in every configured vendor's format, each with the payer for that vendor's request; one entry per vendor, sorted by vendor code. ACTIVE and INACTIVE only
memberId.forVendors[].vendorCARELON | EVICORE | EVOLENT | MHK | ONYX | OPTUMThe vendor code
memberId.forVendors[].memberIdstringThe resolved id in this vendor's format: the member id to put on this vendor's request
memberId.forVendors[].payerIdstringThe payer id to put on this vendor's request
memberId.forVendors[].payerNamestringThe payer name that goes with payerId
lineOfBusinessstringThe line of business Onyx routes on, from the plan in effect on the date of service: SCO, MA-HMO, MA-PPO, D-SNP, MA-TOGETHER, RI-TOGETHER or MA-QHP; a member no rule covers keeps the member record's category (MCR, PP, COM). ACTIVE and INACTIVE only
dateOfServicedate (yyyy-MM-dd)yesThe date evaluated; the first date when a period was asked about
dateOfServiceEnddate (yyyy-MM-dd)The last date evaluated; present only when the request asked about a period
dateOfServiceDefaultedbooleanyestrue when no dateOfService was sent and today was used
coverageobjectThe coverage flag and the coverage period behind it. ACTIVE and INACTIVE only
coverage.coverageIdstringAn id for the coverage period: the resolved id reduced to letters and digits, then the effective and end dates as yyyyMMdd, run together with no separator (39991231 for an open-ended period). Present whenever the dates are; the same member with the same coverage always gets the same value
coverage.activebooleanyesThe flag: true when coverage holds on the date of service, or on every day of the period of service
coverage.effectiveDatedate (yyyy-MM-dd)First day of the coverage period
coverage.endDatedate (yyyy-MM-dd)Last day of the coverage period; 3999-12-31 for an open-ended period
requestIdstringyesThe caller's requestId, echoed
traceIdstringyesThe id of the member lookup behind this answer; quote it to support
sourceMessageobjectWhat the member lookup said when it had no member for the id. NOT_FOUND only, and only when the lookup sent a message
sourceMessage.typestringThe message type as the lookup sent it
sourceMessage.statusstringThe status as the lookup sent it
sourceMessage.codestringThe message code as the lookup sent it
sourceMessage.textstringThe message text as the lookup sent it

An AMBIGUOUS answer never lists the members who share the id.

5 What to do with each answer

Onyx branches on outcome for a 200, and on the HTTP status otherwise. Two rules for every row: Onyx never reformats a member id itself when the service is up, and Onyx keeps the full response with its transaction.

SignalMeaningOnyx action
200 ACTIVEMember found; coverage active on the date of service, or on every day of the period of service (coverage.active is true).Send each vendor its memberId.forVendors entry: the memberId of the entry whose vendor is that vendor, already in the vendor's format, with that entry's payerId and payerName on the request. Route on lineOfBusiness. Keep coverage.coverageId with the transaction as the reference to the coverage period behind the decision.
200 INACTIVEMember found; not covered on that date, or not on every day of the period. message says why.Hold for intake. memberId.forVendors and lineOfBusiness are still there if the business rule says to submit anyway.
200 NOT_FOUNDNo member for this id on that date. sourceMessage carries what the member lookup said, when it sent a message."Member not found" worklist. If Onyx holds a fuller form of the id (for instance with the suffix), one resend with it.
200 AMBIGUOUSSeveral members on the plan share the id and nothing sent tells them apart. Nobody is listed.One resend with dateOfBirth or the member's full id including the suffix. If it is still AMBIGUOUS (twins share a date of birth, or the records carry none), intake takes the full id from the member's card and resends.
400 / 422Request or identity problem (the error catalog below).Never retry. Route by error.code and details[].code.
502 / 503 / 500A lookup behind the service, or the service itself, could not answer.Retry later with a new requestId, honouring Retry-After on a 503; if it persists, park the transaction and alert the service owners.
No response at all (connection refused, timeout)The service is down or unreachable.Rule: pass the member id to the UM vendor exactly as it was received from the EMR, and record the requestId so the transaction can be reconciled later.

6 Errors

Every non-200 answer has one shape. error.code is stable and is what to branch on; details[].code refines it; requestId echoes the caller's id whenever it was usable, so a 400 about another field still carries it; traceId is present once the member lookup was made.

FieldTypeRequiredMeaning
errorobjectyesThe error: a stable code to branch on, a message for a person, and one detail per problem
error.codestringyesINVALID_REQUEST, MEMBER_LOOKUP_REJECTED, DOB_MISMATCH, MEMBER_LOOKUP_ERROR, MEMBER_LOOKUP_INVALID_RESPONSE, MEMBER_LOOKUP_UNAVAILABLE, MEMBER_PLAN_ERROR, MEMBER_PLAN_INVALID_RESPONSE, MEMBER_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE or INTERNAL_ERROR
error.messagestringyesOne sentence for a person
error.details[]arrayOne entry per problem found; every problem with a request is reported together
error.details[].fieldstringThe request field the problem is about, when there is one
error.details[].codestringyesThe detail code that refines error.code, for example MEMBER_ID_MISSING, DATE_OF_SERVICE_INVALID, HTTP_400, READ_TIMEOUT
error.details[].messagestringyesOne sentence for a person
correlationIdstringyesThe X-Correlation-Id of the call, echoed or generated
requestIdstringThe caller's requestId, when the request carried a usable one
traceIdstringThe id of the member lookup behind the answer, present once the lookup was made

Error catalog

HTTPerror.codedetails[].codeMeaning and Onyx action
400INVALID_REQUESTCLIENT_ID_MISSING, CLIENT_ID_INVALID, CLIENT_TYPE_MISSING, CLIENT_TYPE_INVALID, REQUEST_ID_MISSING, REQUEST_ID_INVALID, MEMBER_ID_MISSING, DATE_OF_SERVICE_INVALID, DATE_OF_SERVICE_OUT_OF_RANGE, DATE_OF_SERVICE_END_INVALID, DATE_OF_SERVICE_END_BEFORE_START, DATE_OF_SERVICE_END_WITHOUT_START, DATE_OF_BIRTH_INVALID, DATE_OF_BIRTH_OUT_OF_RANGE, MALFORMED_JSON, WRONG_JSON_TYPENever retry. Every problem with the request is reported together, one detail per problem. MEMBER_ID_MISSING and DATE_OF_SERVICE_OUT_OF_RANGE are provider data; the caller codes are configuration; the rest are mapping defects.
400MEMBER_LOOKUP_REJECTEDHTTP_400The member lookup could not process the request as sent; the message carries its text. Never retry; send the request and the message to the service owners.
422DOB_MISMATCHDOB_MISMATCHThe date of birth matches no record for this id. Manual identity review; never file the authorization.
404, 405, 406, 415INVALID_REQUESTROUTE_NOT_FOUND, METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED, NOT_ACCEPTABLE, UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPEWrong path, method or content type: a connector defect. ROUTE_NOT_FOUND is the only 404 this service returns; a member that is not found is a 200 with outcome NOT_FOUND.
502MEMBER_LOOKUP_ERROR, MEMBER_LOOKUP_INVALID_RESPONSEHTTP_<code>, ERROR_MESSAGE, UNPARSEABLE_BODY, EMPTY_BODY, NO_MEMBER_ID, UNREADABLE_COVERAGE, CLIENT_ERRORThe member lookup answered outside its contract, or with data the service could not read. Park the transaction and alert the service owners.
502MEMBER_PLAN_ERROR, MEMBER_PLAN_INVALID_RESPONSEHTTP_<code>, UNPARSEABLE_BODY, EMPTY_BODY, CLIENT_ERRORThe member plan lookup answered outside its contract, or with data the service could not read. Park the transaction and alert the service owners.
503MEMBER_LOOKUP_UNAVAILABLE, MEMBER_PLAN_UNAVAILABLECONNECT_FAILED, READ_TIMEOUT, HTTP_500, HTTP_5xx, HTTP_429, HTTP_408A lookup could not be reached, timed out or is temporarily unavailable. Retry later with a new requestId, after the Retry-After seconds (10). If it persists, park the transaction and alert the service owners.
500INTERNAL_ERRORThe service itself failed. Retry once later; if it persists, alert the service owners with the correlationId and the requestId.

{ "memberId": "T20262026", "dateOfService": "2027-10-15", "vendor": "EVICORE", "anything": "goes" }

{ "outcome": "INACTIVE",
  "message": "Member found; coverage ended before 2027-10-15",
  "memberId": { "received": "T20262026", "resolved": "T20262026   01",
    "forVendors": [
      { "vendor": "CARELON", "memberId": "T2026202601", "payerId": "Point32Health", "payerName": "Point32Health" },
      { "vendor": "EVICORE", "memberId": "T2026202601", "payerId": "TUFTS", "payerName": "TUFTS" },
      { "vendor": "EVOLENT", "memberId": "T2026202601", "payerId": "Point32Health", "payerName": "Point32Health" },
      { "vendor": "MHK",     "memberId": "T20262026   01", "payerId": "Point32Health", "payerName": "Point32Health" },
      { "vendor": "ONYX",    "memberId": "T2026202601", "payerId": "Point32Health", "payerName": "Point32Health" },
      { "vendor": "OPTUM",   "memberId": "T20262026", "payerId": "Point32Health", "payerName": "Point32Health" }
    ] },
  "lineOfBusiness": "MCR",
  "dateOfService": "2027-10-15", "dateOfServiceDefaulted": false,

The date judged is the date that was sent. This test member's only record runs 01/01/2026 to 12/31/2026, so 2026-10-15 is ACTIVE and 2027-10-15 is INACTIVE. A record with no end date (blank or 12/31/3999) would make a 2027 date ACTIVE, because that is what the record says (section 11).

8 Timeouts, retries, security

  • Timeouts. A successful answer normally takes well under a second. When a lookup behind the service cannot answer, the failure is reported within about 15 seconds; set the client timeout above that.
  • Retries. Retry only on 503 (after Retry-After), on 502 and 500 once, and on no response at all; always with a new requestId. Never retry a 400 or 422.
  • If the service is down. Pass the member id to the UM vendor exactly as it was received from the EMR, and record the requestId so the transaction can be reconciled later.
  • Security. Authentication, certificates and rate limits are handled by Point32Health API Management in front of the service; the credentials come with the base URL. The member id and date of birth are PHI: send them in the body only, never in a URL, and do not log the date of birth.
  • Caller identification. Onyx sends clientId ONYX and clientType EXT on every call, and a new requestId per call; support finds a call by that requestId or by the traceId in the answer.
